result.brief: 提出免训练的步感知记忆重建方法，用离线校准的 Pre-RoPE 仿射去偏与融合替代稠密 t=0 KV 刷新，并配合 Triton 内核，降低长视频扩散的延迟与 FLOPs 并改善后段画质。
result.reason: Training-free KV cache reconstruction for block-causal streaming video diffusion; directly serves long video generation efficiency and conditioning quality, with kernel co-design.
